description: Broadcom BCM2033 USB Bluetooth controllers handled by the bcm203x kernel module (matched by its kernel module alias; the module declares firmware shipped only by bluez-firmware) -> Debian bluez-firmware from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). A proposal only; nothing is installed.

packages.name: bluez-firmware
packages.reason: The bcm203x Bluetooth driver requests the BCM2033 firmware that Debian ships in bluez-firmware.
